text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Summer training camp, during a break between training sessions—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Yes. Feeling the sea breeze drifting from beyond the horizon.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And... the "voices" of the winds walking upon the sea as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It has been echoing endlessly across this sandy beach. At times quiet, at times ferocious—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Enveloping my heart, which boils with excitement for the upcoming race,
even if just for a moment... the wind, and the sound.
choice_data_list: ...Do you mind if I listen in with you?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please do. The "voices" are all so varied,
I could never get tired of listening to them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, as Yamanin Zephyr and I felt the wind and listened to the sound of the waves for a while—
Zephyr!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh, Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Let's play together!
Turbo, Ikuno, Nature, and you—two on two!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bursting onto the scene full of energy was Twin Turbo, the always-full-throttle Umamusume. A moment later, her friends arrived as well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for making such a fuss.
It seems coming to the beach has gotten
Turbo even more hyped up than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, my bad, my bad. Come on, Turbo, let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No way! We can't do a team match with three people!
I want two-on-two! Two-on-two!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a game, competing with others
might provide a different kind of stimulation
than solo training.
choice_data_list: ...For instance, what kind of games do you play?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Well, there's the relay race! And water guns! And cops and robbers, plus—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, beach flags, volleyball...
and for something unique, I'm thinking of sandcastle demolition.
There's a tactical element to it, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Well, with this heat, the ocean, and the sandy beach,
anything we do counts as training, right?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...I see. A training session combined with a match... is that it?
choice_data_list: Since we're here, why not join in for a bit?
Since we're here, wanna join in for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps this, too, is a passing seasonal breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I accept.
If this can serve as an auspicious wind that allows me to soar... even higher.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! Alright, alright,
what should we play first!?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Trainer, which game
did you feel was the most auspicious breeze?
choice_data_list: Beach Relay to Master a Powerful Stride
Let's get used to close contests with Sand Mountain!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Then for now, I shall become
a gust of hot wind blowing across the sandy beach."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a relay showdown was set to take place
between the Yamanin Zephyr & Nice Nature team
and the Twin Turbo & Ikuno Dictus team.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right, Ikuno, I'm leaving the anchor leg to you!
I'm gonna pull ahead by a crazy-huge lead!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I have high expectations. However, please be mindful of your pacing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, leave the second half to me.
I'm looking forward to your performance, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If you can embody a whirlwind run
that kicks up even the sand...
then the winds of victory will naturally blow.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Hang in there, Zephyr!
Keep widening that lead~!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"*gasp!* *pant!*
Da-dammit...! I... I won't, lose...!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Turbo... However, this is within expectations.
As the lead widens, complacency is bound to set in—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(The dirt is catching my legs more than I expected...!
But... the me of right now can handle it!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Let my legs ride the wind—
As if taking flight!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAHH!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, whoa, whoa!
How far are you going, Zephyr?!
You're already passing it!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...She truly swept through
just like a gust of wind, didn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the excitement gradually heated up.
We kept swapping teams and continued
enjoying beach flags, volleyball, and more.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that game. You stick a twig on top of a sand pile
and take turns shaving away at the mound bit by bit.
Whoever knocks the stick over loses.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Composure and tactics are the key, huh.
I need to keep my mind as calm as still water."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, it was decided that Twin Turbo & Yamanin Zephyr
would face off against Nice Nature & Ikuno Dictus, but—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Take thiiiiiis!!
Turbo Shovel, goooo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, didn't you shave off way too much right away!?
The sandcastle looks like a candle now!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"...She didn't fall.
It was a bold move, but by no means the wrong one."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, now that it's thinner,
the center of gravity is clear...
The safe zone is—right here!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!? It looks like an apple core now!
Can you handle it, Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
......
Calm the mind, and discern—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (...What I must read is the flow of the sand. The flow of the sea breeze.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(...Apple Core-san.
Which way is your "wind" blowing—)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Right here!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
!? Whoa, seriously?!
And here I was so sure of our win...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the excitement gradually heated up.
We kept swapping teams and continued
enjoying beach flags, volleyball, and more.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoa~! They took the set~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Disguising a drop shot at the net
as a spike to the back court... splendidly done.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu. The sea breeze of Urakaze guided me.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And now... an auspicious breeze is blowing our way as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As they repeated match after match,
before they knew it, the sun began to set—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
“—It's hard to say goodbye, but
shall we head back to the training camp lodgings soon?”

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I kept you hanging around for quite a while.
Thanks to you, though, it was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Let's play again, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Whenever a refreshing breeze blows once again—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"—Phew. I didn't even notice
the sun had set.
I must be a little tired..."
choice_data_list: I'm glad you looked like you were having fun.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...Before I knew it,
many winds were blowing around me."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Valiant as a fierce wind, lively like thunderclaps...
and gentle as a southern breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
—These memories brought by the ocean breeze.
I'm sure... I will never forget them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A quiet moment born during the camp.
It seemed to provide Yamanin Zephyr with a
wonderfully refreshing change of pace.
